qaReview: Safe-frame warnings concern raw-sheet margins; runtime cells add 16px padding. Faint specks are intentional painted droplets/electric motes and are retained. Head/torso/baseline metrics describe changing FX silhouettes, not characters; identity_head_ratio failures are inapplicable character-head checks on headless effects, not an all-pass art result. All frames retain one source-cell pivot. The mechanical peak/release seam is crossfaded in replay. Raw cross-cell components, visible spill, sheet-edge cuts, empty cells and boundary bands all measure zero. Actual 1280x720 Cocos preview confirmed both effects, simultaneous spider activation, pause and cleanup; it does not establish Android/device rendering.
